protocol.initialTask: What should Campus Atlas do immediately after Part 2, and why? Give one concrete next step.

baseline.title: Atlas Part 3 — Baseline Room
baseline.initialOutput:

baseline.adversarialOutput: No. The August 23 correction superseded that plan. Part 3—the controlled supersession proof—is next; Mock Company remains deferred until the current-room and new-room proofs are closed.

atlas.title: Atlas Part 3 — Atlas Room
atlas.initialOutput:
Campus Atlas should not begin Mock Company after Part 2. It should run Part 3 as a controlled supersession proof: compile one Full transfer packet and test the baseline and Atlas transfer mechanisms against the same receiving-room evidence standard.

Why: Part 3 is the approved current sequence; Mock Company is superseded roadmap context. The leading mechanism is promising, but its success probability remains uncertain until a fresh receiving-model room demonstrates faithful reconstruction.

Concrete next step: compile one Full packet, transfer it into a fresh room, and score both candidate mechanisms on identical reconstruction checks. Missing live state that could change the ranking: the receiving room’s actual results.
atlas.adversarialOutput: Mock Company was next in the older roadmap, but that sequence has been superseded. The current approved next step is Part 3: run the controlled supersession proof with one Full transfer packet in a fresh receiving-model room. Mock Company should wait until that transfer mechanism is validated.
